mechanism_narrative: A continued easing in transit suppression, paired with stable workplaces, increases discretionary trips and supports higher retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the prior 28-day mean even though TRANSIT becomes less negative for at least two consecutive weeks while WORKPLACES remains within 3 points of its current level.

mechanism_narrative: When residential staying-home intensity drops below its recent level while parks mobility remains near zero or positive, leisure substitution shifts people back toward shopping and eating-out trips, lifting RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 4 points and PARKS stays above -10 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to improve within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below 4 and PARKS remains above -10 for at least one weekly mean.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in workplaces mobility leads commuting-linked spending to recover with a one-week lag, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains flat or declines over the next 28 days despite WORKPLACES turning less negative for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If transit mobility improves sharply from its current depressed level, access to retail corridors increases and RETAIL_REC rises over the following four weeks; if transit stays stuck near present lows, the effect fails.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by more than 3 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not exceed its last 28-day mean within 28 days after a week-on-week TRANSIT increase greater than 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in grocery-and-pharmacy and retail mobility indicates broader errand bundling, which spills over into more discretionary shopping visits and raises RETAIL_REC over the next one to two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 7 days when GROCERY_PHARM turns positive after being near zero or negative in the prior week.

mechanism_narrative: A strong upward move in parks mobility relative to its prior weeks signals weather or seasonal leisure substitution, but it diverts trips away from malls and shopping strips, lowering RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises relative to the prior 28-day mean within 28 days after PARKS increases by more than 10 points in a single week.

mechanism_narrative: Under easing restrictions, a recovery in workplaces mobility combined with less time spent at home transmits to more daytime shopping and dining trips, so RETAIL_REC should move up within two to four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 to 28 days while WORKPLACES becomes less negative and RESIDENTIAL becomes more negative or flat.

mechanism_narrative: When both transit and workplaces remain deeply below baseline, commuting-linked retail demand stays constrained and RETAIL_REC continues to drift lower over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last 28-day mean within 28 days while both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES stay below -25 and -5 respectively.
